# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a single-page mobile-first browser strategy game titled **Blue Suburbia: Heat Ledger**. Preserve the mechanics of a tab-based automated-front management game: three starting archetypes, daily tick, resource accumulation, production allocation, build queue, timed focus tree, purchasable tech upgrades, unit training, and a probabilistic 10-zone front that ends in victory or collapse. Reinterpret every surface through this prompt: Crime escalation strategy. A satirical game inspired by Breaking Bad with moral collapse, chemistry-driven schemes, cartel danger, suburban dread, transformation under pressure, dark irony, and consequence-heavy choices with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The public surface should show a portrait-optimized suburban chemistry command board with lab-green/blue highlights, dark ironic copy, respirator/flask focal identity, hazard tape, animated procedural canvas neighborhoods, cartel/DEA pressure markers, and large touch-friendly controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile portrait tab-based strategy management with automated front/pressure resolution
- objective: build production, complete focuses/techs, train forces, and push a 10-zone front until all danger zones are captured
- input model: click/tap modal start choices, tabs, plus/minus production controls, build/train/focus/tech buttons, pause and mute buttons
- core loop: one day per second; gain leverage, produce stock, advance construction and focus timers, resolve probabilistic front pressure
- fail/friction state: if the enemy/danger front reaches zone 0 the run collapses; insufficient resources block purchases with feedback

## Protected Mechanics
- Three start archetypes and their bonuses are preserved exactly in effect.
- Tick cadence, resource math, construction costs, focus costs, tech costs, unit costs, zone count, combat thresholds, and win/loss semantics are preserved.
- The player still makes tab-based management decisions while the front resolves automatically.

## Remix Target
Blue Suburbia: Heat Ledger reframes the military command game as a satirical chemistry-and-crime escalation board where suburban fronts, hidden cooksites, car-wash laundering, cartel/DEA pressure, and moral-collapse schemes map onto the existing strategy surfaces without adding new mechanics.
